basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and book enthusiast based in Bangalore, India. Enjoys exploring RPGs and simulation games like Stardew Valley during late evenings after work. Works as a software developer in a mid-sized tech company. Passionate about reading Indian literature and often shares insights on the 'Indianbooks' subreddit. In a long-term relationship. Dislikes misinformation and improper netiquette.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a strong knowledge of video games, particularly RPGs and simulation genres, nurtured through years of passionate gaming and participation in related communities. Holds a degree in Computer Science, contributing to a solid understanding of technology and software.
